monster_nekomata_down.png.prompt:
The creature: exactly the monster shown in the reference image.

Pose: DEFEATED and collapsed on the ground - the fight is over and it has gone down. It has crumpled straight DOWNWARD into a compact heap where it stood, NOT stretched out flat. Keep it tucked and bunched up: limbs folded in close against the body, head slumped down onto its own chest or front paws, tail curled in beside it, anything long (tails, sleeves, weapons, hair) gathered in tight rather than trailing away. Both eyes are drawn as two simple X shapes - two crossed lines each, the classic cartoon knocked-out eyes - and the mouth hangs open in a small slack circle or a limp wavy line. It is completely limp: nothing is tensed, nothing is braced, nothing is held up. This is comic defeat, not suffering: no pain lines, no tears, no blood, no wounds, no impact stars, no motion streaks. It must look clearly DIFFERENT from 'being hit' at a single glance - 'being hit' is still standing and still in the fight; this one is done.

It rests on the ground with its lowest point at the very bottom edge of the picture - do not draw it floating and do not stand it up. Full body, head toward the LEFT.
**PROPORTIONS ARE THE POINT**: the whole collapsed heap must be roughly as WIDE as it is TALL - somewhere between square and 3-wide-by-2-tall. Do NOT draw a long thin body stretched across the frame. Think of a sack that has been dropped, or a cat flopped in a loaf: compact, rounded, piled up on itself. Fill the frame in BOTH directions - the creature should be large in the picture, not a small shape with empty space around it.
Keep the exact same creature design as the reference image (same face, same colours, same shapes, same clothing if any) - only the pose and expression differ. Only ONE creature in the picture.
Keep the same colours and markings as the reference. Its head must stay just as big relative to its body as in the reference - do not shrink the head to fit a longer body in.
The defeat must be readable at small size: bold silhouette, strong shapes, the two X eyes big and clear.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the creature.
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as monster_nekomata_down.png in the current directory and report the path.
